title: Merge Report
description: Output from merge-normalizer documenting how sections were assembled, what voice inconsistencies were found, and whether normalization was applied. Consumed by lead-editor and QA workflow.

merge_id.description: Unique identifier for this merge operation

outline_id.description: ID of the outline whose sections were merged

run_id.description: Cache run ID this report belongs to

sections_merged.description: Status record for each section from the outline

section_id.description: ID matching the section_id in outline.json

status.description: complete = section is fully drafted; placeholder = structure-only, awaiting content; blocked = could not be drafted (see blocker_ref)

blocker_ref.description: Blocker report ID or description if status is blocked or placeholder

word_count.description: Actual word count of the drafted section

voice_agent.description: ID of the section-drafter agent that produced this section

voice_issues.description: Voice inconsistencies detected across sections during assembly

sections.description: Section IDs involved in the voice inconsistency

issue.description: Description of the voice inconsistency — specific pattern identified (e.g. 'Section 2 uses formal register while Sections 1 and 3 use conversational register')

resolution.description: How the inconsistency was resolved, or why it was left for lead-editor review

normalization_applied.description: True if merge-normalizer made automated voice normalization changes to the assembled draft

normalization_notes.description: Summary of what normalization was applied and which sections were affected

draft_path.description: File path of the assembled draft output

created_by.description: Agent ID that produced this merge report (typically merge-normalizer)
